fact: Benin adopted its National Artificial Intelligence and Big Data Strategy (SNIAM 2023-2027) in January 2023, at an estimated cost of about USD 7.7 million over five years, to be implemented through a public-private partnership with funding sought from government, private and external sources.
title: Benin: Anticipating the impacts of artificial intelligence on West Africa's aspiring digital services hub
publisher: Ministry of Digital Economy and Communications (International Science Council case study)
